reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: OWN-09 retains saved termios state, native capability pointers, a shared output buffer and a tty descriptor. open_tty_with_ownership distinguishes an opened FD from borrowed fallback fd 2.
owner_creation.invariant: Terminal value snapshots and descriptor provenance are separate owners.
limitations: The legacy open_tty wrapper returns only the integer and drops provenance metadata.

aliases_escapes.analysis: OWN-09 tparm returns native scratch storage, while ltputs can lend a local 64-byte string to tputs synchronously. Neither result is an application allocation to retain or free arbitrarily.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Native scratch and stack text must obey the provider call lifetime.
limitations: Provider storage lifetime is not established by the Rust pointer type.

callback_targets.analysis: OWN-09 cost passes inc_costcount to tputs with a C int-to-int signature; do_tputs forwards the selected callback and text directly to the provider.
callback_targets.invariant: Native output callbacks require correct ABI and scoped execution.
limitations: M0-ABI-001 remains open beyond matching this local signature.

invalidation.analysis: OWN-09 saved termios survives attempted restoration, and native capability output reuses mutable provider/application context. Borrowed tty fallback remains owned by its original standard stream.
invalidation.invariant: A failed mode change must not retire the saved snapshot.
limitations: Source review gives no independent native-provider lifetime proof.

mutation_commit.analysis: OWN-09 commits in_raw_mode only after successful tcsetattr; buffered output advances written on positive writes and retries EINTR. Current code repairs the silent-error mechanisms of M0-TERM-001 and M0-IO-002.
mutation_commit.invariant: A failed native operation must not be recorded as a successful transition.
limitations: The maintained historical findings remain open despite these current checks.

release_pair.analysis: OWN-09 terminal teardown includes mode restoration, while close_getchr is currently empty. A static termios snapshot and provider scratch are not heap allocations that can be freed by terminal cleanup.
release_pair.invariant: Descriptor release must follow provenance rather than numeric slot alone.
limitations: This packet does not claim a final close for the persistent tty descriptor.

error_cleanup.analysis: OWN-09 output failure sets a sticky flag and returns false; permanent restore failure diagnoses without changing in_raw_mode. quit later upgrades a successful status if either failure remains recorded.
error_cleanup.invariant: Cleanup must preserve failure status without inventing mode restoration.
limitations: A diagnostic cannot guarantee the OS accepted the requested terminal mode.

signals_handoff.analysis: OWN-09 can be entered by terminate -> quit, which performs terminal teardown, output flush and raw-mode restoration. M0-SIG-003 remains open because that work runs from the asynchronous handler path.
signals_handoff.invariant: Terminal session ownership requires ordinary serialized cleanup.
limitations: The traced handler path is not an independent execution result.

src/pager.rs.relationship: quit at src/pager.rs:948-970 invokes terminal teardown, output flush and raw_mode(false); src/pager.rs:967-981 consumes sticky terminal/output failures for exit status.

src/signal.rs.relationship: terminate at src/signal.rs:83-85 calls quit directly, establishing asynchronous entry into the terminal/output cleanup examined by OWN-09.
